verdict.rationale: Airbyte's docs call Airbyte Core "Airbyte's open source product" and abctl "Airbyte's open source command line tool", and a public GitHub repository (airbytehq/airbyte) exists, so the source is readable. However, the evidence never names the license. A community report also states the project is "not a fully open source project" with non-free parts, so coverage is partial rather than complete. missing for 10: the specific open license (e.g., an OSI-approved name or LICENSE file) is never identified, there is no evidence on which parts are under which license given the reported non-free components, and there is no independent confirmation that all product source is openly licensed.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: This quickstart guides you through deploying a local instance of Airbyte Core, Airbyte's open source product.
abctl is Airbyte's open source command line tool to create and manage local instances of Airbyte running in Docker.
Airbyte is an open source platform designed for building and managing data pipelines
